name: library-management-system
description: LibTrack is a responsive Library Management System built as a college Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA) mini project. It pairs a retro editorial, hand-printed paper aesthetic (thick black ink borders, warm cream paper, offset drop shadows, zero gradients) with custom, dynamically allocated C++ data structures exposed via a minimal HTTP REST API.

scripts.test: node tests/test_dsa.js && python3 tests/test_api.py && python3 tests/test_workflow.py
